thread:
kai: Heads-up: BlueHelm wants to list a Manila region hardware-backed SKU (pilot).
They're requesting entitlement approval, cert pinning for our SI, and a minimum committed pool. Timeline: pilot in 4 weeks.
neha: do we have the SKU id from their side? and is this pure marketplace or via an SI bundle?
kai: placeholder SKU BH-PH-HW-01. It's a joint SI bundle (BlueHelm + local integrator). They want telemetry hooks enabled for usage billing.
omar: ops concerns: Manila requires explicit ASN peering for the integrator; also need a cert rotation plan if we're doing mTLS to the SI. can someone surface the cert lifecycle expectations?
grace: legal will need to see whether BlueHelm or the integrator is responsible for cert rotation and vulnerability disclosures. if redwood manages certs there are extra compliance checks.
neha: partner prefers redwood-managed attestation for the first 30 days of the pilot to simplify onboarding, then transition to partner-managed mTLS. that's their ask.
kai: noted. ops question: what capacity floor are we committing? partner asked for 6 H100-equivalent GPUs plus 40 vCPU for control plane, 2TB egress/mo baseline, burst to 12 GPUs for load spikes.
omar: ops OK on those numbers but need quota pre-approve. also request a network carve (subnet) per SI to avoid cross-tenant traffic.
grace: draft MOA items: who holds keys, who does incident notif, SLA credit triggers for throughput. I'll add a clause about cert rotation window (48h) and telemetry access (read-only) for partner.
neha: marketing note: BlueHelm wants a co-branded one-pager at listing; they flagged joint launch comms if pilot metrics > 90p latency and < $X/token.
kai: I'll coordinate comms later. immediate ask: vote on redwood-managed certs for pilot OR insist partner-managed. please reply with "+managed" or "+partner" and short reason. deadline EOD tomorrow so we can file entitlement.
omar: +managed (ops will provide rotation logs; reduces finger-pointing during pilot)
grace: +partner (legal prefers partner ownership to avoid holding PII access keys)
neha: +managed (speed of launch; partner ok to transition after 30d)
kai: thanks. i'll capture decision as redwood-manage certs for pilot with transition clause in MOA.
marketplace-bot: ticket created: MKP-2246  entitlement request + cert lifecycle diagram (assignee: omar). ETA: 2026-05-10.
kai: omar can you add the ASN/peering checklist to the ticket and estimate time to complete the subnet carve?
omar: will add checklist by EOD and estimate ~3 business days to provision peering + subnet once quota approved.
marketplace-bot: reminder: entitlement sync scheduled 2026-05-08 09:30 PHT (calendar invite sent).
kai: I'll intro BlueHelm PM on the partner thread after legal posts MOA redlines. tagging @marco_bluehelm. ping if any blockers.
